The build-out in five acts

  1. The shock (Nov 2022 – 2023). ChatGPT creates demand no one planned for; NVIDIA's May 2023 guidance starts the H100 scramble.
  2. The arms race (2024). Clouds and labs race for GPUs and power; Blackwell arrives and Sequoia asks who will pay.
  3. Mega-projects and circular deals (2025). Stargate, the DeepSeek scare, then suppliers funding their customers: NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom with OpenAI.
  4. Agents, memory and balance sheets (H1 2026). Coding agents drive revenue, memory prices spike, and hyperscalers borrow.
  5. Public markets (mid-2026). SpaceX lists, Anthropic and OpenAI file for IPOs, and Oracle's credit is cut.

The turning points

The 21 events that changed the direction of the build-out. Each links to its place in the full timeline, where it is highlighted.

  • 30 Nov 2022ChatGPT launches
  • May 2023NVIDIA's guidance shock: FY24 Q2 guided to $11bn vs ~$7bn expected
  • 20 Jun 2024Sequoia asks "AI's $600B question"
  • Dec 2024OpenAI's o1 reasoning model and ChatGPT Pro ($200)
  • 21 Jan 2025Stargate announced: $500B, 10 GW (OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle, MGX)
  • 27 Jan 2025DeepSeek R1 "efficiency shock": NVIDIA falls 17% (−$600B) in a day
  • 22 Sep 2025NVIDIA–OpenAI letter of intent: 10 GW and up to $100B of investment
  • 6 Oct 2025AMD–OpenAI: 6 GW of GPUs plus a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares
  • Oct 2025Memory prices start to spike: conventional DRAM contracts +45–50% q/q
  • 29 Oct 2025NVIDIA becomes the first company worth $5 trillion
  • Dec 2025PJM's 2027/28 capacity auction clears at the $333.44 cap with its first-ever shortfall (6.6 GW)
  • 12 Jan 2026Claude Cowork launches; the SaaS sell-off begins
  • Jan 2026DRAM contract prices jump ~93–98% in a quarter, a record
  • 2 Feb 2026SpaceX acquires xAI in an all-stock deal ($250B for xAI, $1T for SpaceX)
  • 31 Mar 2026OpenAI closes $122B at $852B (Amazon $50B, NVIDIA $30B, SoftBank $30B)
  • Apr 2026Anthropic's run-rate passes $30B, overtaking OpenAI
  • 26 May 2026Micron's market value passes $1 trillion
  • 1 Jun 2026Anthropic (1 Jun) and OpenAI (8 Jun) file confidentially for IPOs
  • 12 Jun 2026SpaceX IPO raises ~$75B at ~$1.77T, the largest ever
  • 9 Jul 2026S&P cuts Oracle to BBB-, one notch above junk
  • 17 Aug 2026NVIDIA guarantees up to $105bn of OpenAI's Ohio leases (8 GW, with SoftBank)
